preconditions.description: Input string s has length between 1 and 1000, and integer k is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s contains only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if (len(s) % k == 0) and all(s[i:i+l] == s[i:i+l][::-1] for i in range(0, len(s), l) for l in [len(s)//k]) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if and only if s can be split into k palindromes of equal length (i.e., len(s) is divisible by k and each segment of length len(s)//k is a palindrome).
